'''Slumbering Transcendence''', which have been crafted before, can be upgraded into [[Transcendence]] still. }} [[Slumbering Transcendence]] is a [[PvP]]-exclusive [[legendary trinket]] without any visual effect. == Acquisition == === Historical recipes === * After the [[Game updates/2021-07-13|July 13, 2021]] ([[Legendary Armory]] release), these recipes craft [[Transcendence]] directly. {{Recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Gift of the Champion | ingredient2 = 1 Mist Pendant | ingredient3 = 1 Mystic Tribute | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Skirmishing | status = historical }} == Used in == === Historical === {{recipe list}} == Vendors == {{Vendor query table|currency=Slumbering Transcendence|showCostText=true}} == Available prefixes == * The following [[Attribute combinations|prefixes]] can be selected: {{prefix selection|all legendary trinket}} == Notes == * Slumbering Transcendence was released alongside the [[Visions of the Past: Steel and Fire]] update on [[Game updates/2020-03-17|March 17, 2020]]. * [[Transcendence]] provides the same benefits as Slumbering Transcendence and additionally has visual effects. * Slumbering Transcendence is not added into the [[Legendary Armory]]. * Slumbering Transcendence can be exchanged for [[Transcendence]] at [[Grandmaster Craftsman Hobbs]].
